days.title: Embark in Aswan
days.description: Check in and have lunch on board, with afternoon tea. Overnight in Aswan.

days.title: Aswan: High Dam, Philae and the Nubian Museum
days.description: Visit the High Dam, Philae Temple and the Nubian Museum. Nubian party in the evening.

days.title: Kom Ombo
days.description: Sail to Kom Ombo and visit its temple. Gala dinner, then sail to Edfu.

days.title: Edfu and Luxor
days.description: Visit the Temple of Horus at Edfu, then sail to Luxor through the Esna lock.

days.title: Luxor
days.description: Visit the Valley of the Kings, the Valley of the Queens and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut on the West Bank, then the Karnak and Luxor Temples. Belly dance show in the evening.

days.title: Dendera
days.description: Sail to Qena and visit the Temple of Dendera, then sail on to Naga Hammadi.

days.title: Abydos
days.description: Sail to El Balyana and visit the Temple of Abydos, then sail to Sohag. Galabia party in the evening.

days.title: Towards Tell el-Amarna
days.description: Sail from Sohag through the Asyut lock to Tell el-Amarna, passing the Monastery of Prince Tadros, which your guide explains from the boat.

days.title: Tell el-Amarna and Tuna el-Gebel
days.description: Visit the northern tombs, the Royal Tomb of Akhenaten, the Northern Palace and the small temples of the Aten, then Tuna el-Gebel. Sail to Minya, with a folklore party.

days.title: Beni Hassan
days.description: Drive about an hour to the rock tombs of Beni Hassan, including those of Baqet III, Khety, Amenemhat and Khnumhotep II. Sail to Beni Suef.

days.title: Coptic Cairo
days.description: Sail to Cairo and visit the Hanging Church, the Coptic Museum and the synagogue. Takht, a traditional Arabic music ensemble, in the evening.

days.title: Giza and the Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description: Visit the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx and the Grand Egyptian Museum.

days.title: Disembarkation in Cairo
days.description: Breakfast and disembarkation.

days.title: Embark in Cairo
days.description: Check in and have lunch on board. Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Coptic Cairo and Giza
days.description: Visit the synagogue, the Hanging Church and the Coptic Museum, then the Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx.

days.title: Memphis, Saqqara and the Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description: Visit Memphis, Saqqara and the Grand Egyptian Museum. Welcome cocktail reception, gala dinner and Takht music.

days.title: Sailing to Beni Suef
days.description: A full day on the river to Beni Suef, with a singer at dinner.

days.title: Sailing to Minya
days.description: Sail to Minya, with a folklore party in the evening.

days.title: Tuna el-Gebel and Beni Hassan
days.description: Visit Tuna el-Gebel, then drive about an hour to the rock tombs of Beni Hassan, including those of Baqet III, Khety, Amenemhat and Khnumhotep II.

days.title: Tell el-Amarna
days.description: Visit the northern tombs, the Royal Tomb of Akhenaten, the Northern Palace and the small temples of the Aten. Sail to Asyut, passing the Monastery of Prince Tadros. Galabia party in the evening.

days.title: Sailing to Sohag
days.description: A day on the river to Sohag.

days.title: Abydos
days.description: Sail to El Balyana and visit the Temple of Abydos and the temple of Seti I. Sail on to Naga Hammadi through its lock and bridges.

days.title: Dendera
days.description: Sail to Qena and visit the Temple of Dendera, about 20 minutes by road. Sail to Luxor, with a belly dance show.

days.title: Luxor West Bank
days.description: Visit the Valley of the Kings and the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut. Belly dance show in the evening.

days.title: Luxor East Bank and Edfu
days.description: Visit the Karnak and Luxor Temples, then sail towards Edfu through the Esna lock.

days.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo
days.description: Visit the Temple of Horus at Edfu, then sail to Kom Ombo and visit its temple. Continue to Aswan.

days.title: Aswan
days.description: Visit the High Dam, Philae Temple and the Nubian Museum. Nubian party in the evening.

vessels.booking: On request, no fixed dates (not Christmas or New Year): 4, 5, 6 or 7 nights from Luxor or Aswan, minimum 4. Sails with one suite booked. Check-in 12:00, check-out 08:00. Soft all-inclusive, local alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks included.
